race.title: Book Online At DundalkStadium.com Nursery Handicap
race.verdict: INVINCIBLE IRISH improved when runner-up at Down Royal last time and can go one place better over a trip that promises to suit. Stablemate Dragon Scales is also respected on her debut in nursery company, with Professor Finnegan completing the shortlist. INVINCIBLE IRISH (IRE) DRAGON SCALES (IRE) PROFESSOR FINNEGAN (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Invincible Irish (7/4), Lady H (4/1), Professor Finnegan (5/1), Syrah (11/2), Dear Theodosia (7/1), Dragon Scales (12/1), Imply (20/1), Savannah Sun (25/1), Lady Quigley (25/1)
